name: Easy Pay
description: Chat with AI to create payment links with itemized receipts (payments mocked).

OPENROUTER_API_KEY.description: OpenRouter API key (https://openrouter.ai/keys). Leave empty to use the offline parser.

ADMIN_EMAILS.description: Emails that can open the platform admin panel at /admin (comma-separated).

APP_URL.description: Public URL of the app, e.g. https://my-easy-pay.herokuapp.com (used for Stripe redirects).

STRIPE_SECRET_KEY.description: Stripe secret key (US and other countries). Empty = demo payments. See PAYMENTS.md.

STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET.description: Signing secret of the Stripe webhook endpoint.

PLATFORM_FEE_BPS.description: Platform fee outside Brazil, basis points (100 = 1%).

MP_CLIENT_ID.description: Mercado Pago app Client ID (Brazil). Empty = demo payments for Brazilian sellers.

RESEND_API_KEY.description: resend.com key for verification and password-reset emails.

PLATFORM_FEE_BPS_BR.description: Platform fee in Brazil, basis points (150 = 1.5%).
